name: inline-images
description: Draws the images you paste, the images tools return and the files Claude sends inline in the terminal transcript, instead of [Image #1] text. /image or a click on a caption opens a lightbox to step through them and zoom.

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: auto: real pixels where Claude Code draws them (kitty, Ghostty, or CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TERMINAL_IMAGES), block symbols elsewhere (Warp, iTerm2, Terminal). symbols, blocks (plain half blocks) or pixels force one.

maxColumns.title: Max width (columns)
maxColumns.description: Widest an image is drawn, in terminal columns.

maxRows.title: Max height (rows)
maxRows.description: Tallest an image is drawn, in terminal rows.
